verdict.rationale: Statsig documents gradual feature rollouts through Feature Gates configured as Scheduled Rollouts. Gates change behavior in real time without deploying new code, and evaluation is deterministic: the same user and gate state always return the same result across client and server. The evidence never explicitly describes percentage-based allocation or ramping from 1% to 100%, so coverage of the core mechanic is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of percentage pass rates and a 1%-to-100% ramp, an explicit statement that bucketing stays consistent as the percentage increases, and independent or hands-on corroboration of progressive rollouts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll a flag out progressively by percentage with consistent bucketing, ramping from 1% to 100% without redeploying
